project.description: Build+deploy pic-sure-operations-service (Phase 4: sole pic-sure-DB owner; /configuration, /dataset, internal query API). Builds services/pic-sure-operations-service from the monorepo. git_hash defaults to the rewrite branch during migration.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/operations" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
# Build ONLY the services/pic-sure-operations-service module (+ its reactor deps) from the pic-sure monorepo. # Never builds pic-sure-legacy (quarantined), so it cannot touch the frozen Java 11 line. docker run --rm \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn -B -pl services/pic-sure-operations-service -am clean package -DskipTests"
# env-file cascade (uploaded param > existing config > warn) if [ -f operations.env ]; then echo "A new operations.env was loaded." cp operations.env "$CONFIG_DIR/operations.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/operations.env" ]; then echo "Using existing operations.env" else echo "WARNING: no operations.env present -- required secrets (datasource/HPDS/internal token) will be missing." touch "$CONFIG_DIR/operations.env" fi
# build the runtime image (jar from the Maven step) docker build -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-operations-service:LATEST services/pic-sure-operations-service/
# (re)deploy on the picsure network docker rm -f pic-sure-operations-service 2>/dev/null || true docker run --name=pic-sure-operations-service --restart always --network=picsure \ --env-file "$CONFIG_DIR/operations.env" \ -d hms-dbmi/pic-sure-operations-service:LATEST \ || exit 2
# smoke -- poll the service health from inside the network for i in $(seq 1 18); do if docker run --rm --network=picsure busybox wget -qO- http://pic-sure-operations-service:8080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "operations-service is healthy." exit 0 fi sleep 5 done echo "ERROR: operations-service did not become healthy within 90s" docker logs --tail 60 pic-sure-operations-service exit 2
